This is the first skill quest for [[Ranger]] characters. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | profession = ranger | primary = y | test = n }} ===Objectives=== * Find the river skale queen and slay her. * Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 25 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) * {{skill icon|Power Shot}} * {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}} ==Walkthrough== Head south towards the river. The River Skale Queen should be on the other side of it. You can use the Control key (Ctrl) to see the name of any foes within the range of the [[radar]]. They will appear in red on your screen. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Skale]] *{{e}} 0 [[River Skale Tad]] *{{e}} 0 [[River Skale Queen]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Artemis the Ranger :''"A horde of '''skale''' down by the '''river road''' has been hunting human prey to feed to their queen.
